authority.scope: Accept the displayed completed Red Planet Protector source rebuild and continue the approved T082 work; correct the 7313 source description without changing gameplay, production status or Canon.

approvalEvidence.scope: The displayed Rev1 Red Planet Protector is accepted for comparative appearance review only; this does not approve production integration, exact piece topology, source colors, gameplay-camera readability or the connected Protector Stance transformation.

finding: Rev1 restores the completed 7313 read as a low broad removable wedge craft docked above a slim twin-legged base. Centauri is visible through the closed tapered canopy; the upper weapons are deliberately unequal, with one long viewer-left dish cannon and one short viewer-right emitter; two lower fan pods and their separate thin side lances remain visible without becoming arms or duplicate cannons.
pending: Exact production piece topology and hidden connection legality
Continuous connected Mobile-to-Protector-Stance mechanism and Guard Sweep presentation
historicalBoundary: FullV2 Rev3 remains rejected historical evidence: its empty opaque cockpit, spherical humanoid torso and duplicated large upper dishes came from an incorrect source description. This approval selects only source-rebuild Rev1 for comparative appearance review and does not approve exact LEGO construction, production integration, gameplay behavior or the source toy's hand-rebuilt flight conversion as an in-game mechanism.
